why_this_matters: GROUND-TRUTH AGGRESSOR DIRECTION (taker_direction/maker_direction) — the field our fee model had to upper-bound as 'all taker' because paper fills never recorded maker/taker
REAL PER-FILL FEES (fee_usdc) — lets us calibrate/verify the Polymarket fee formula fee=C*rate*p*(1-p) against actual charged fees instead of assuming a category rate

OrderFilled/2026_04.parquet.note: modern fee regime: 88% of fills carry a fee; single month totals $569M in fees on this exchange
